en: Meow... Nice to mewt you! I'm a little thief... And I stole your map and flashlight!
You will have to solve this level without seeing what the map looks like...
Don't worry, I'm not that mean. I have exchanged your map with someone else's... Why don't you ask around?
Perhaps you can start with your neighbour...
